essays.text:
Paragraph 2 of Article 22 of the R.O.C. Patent Act provides: “An invention …can be easily made by a person ordinarily skilled in the art based on prior artshall not be patented.” Please elaborate on:
① The nature of “a person ordinarily skilled in the art.”（10 分）
② In making a judgment under this paragraph, several steps must be taken.Please describe what these steps are.（20 分）

Please translate the following extract from an opinion of the Supreme Courtinto English:按專利侵權之判斷流程，第一步驟係解釋專利請求項，第二步驟係分析專利之技術特徵及被控侵權對象對應之技術內容，並進行比對，先判斷被控侵權對象是否符合「文義讀取」；若不符合「文義讀取」，而專利權人主張適用「均等論」時，再判斷被控侵權對象是否適用「均等論」。（20 分）

mcq.q: Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following patent category requires the patentees to present thetechnical evaluation reports in order to warn the potential infringers?
Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following method is not stipulated for calculating damages?
opts: The method set forth in Article 216 of the R.O.C. Civil Code
The profit earned by the infringer from patent infringement
The amount calculated on the basis of reasonable royalties
The statutory damages authorized by the R.O.C. Patent Act

mcq.q: Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following patent category has primary protection on theornamental appearance and visual appeal of products?
According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, under what condition could the right to apply for a patent be assignedor abandoned while such right is jointly owned by two or more persons or entities?
opts: Consent of two-thirds of joint owners

mcq.q: Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following circumstance does not lead to the extinguishment ofa patent right?
opts: The patentee has charged excessive royalties
The patentee has passed away without heirs

mcq.q: Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following subject could be granted a design patent?
opts: The shape of an article solely dictated by its function
The layout of integrated circuits and electronic circuits
The graphic user interface applied to an article

mcq.q: Which of the following is not the requirement for patentability?
＿＿＿is found where the accused subject matter falls precisely within the express boundaries of thepatent claim.
Which of the following cannot be used as a defense against patent infringement accusations?
Which of the following can be used as extrinsic evidence in claim interpretation?
Which of the following issue could possibly be argued in patent litigation while the claims employ wordsof degree, such as“close to,”“approximately,”“substantially equal,”or“closely approximate”?

Which of the following requirement mandates the patentee to disclose sufficient information in the patentapplication so that a skilled artisan would be able to practice the claimed invention without undueexperimentation?

The court has the discretion to increase the damages up to three times the amount found or assessed. Theso-called“enhanced damages”are frequently awarded when the infringer acted in blatant disregard of thepatentee’s rights. This circumstance is termed＿＿＿.
According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
opts: The pledgee of the patent right shall not be allowed to exploit the right, unless the patentee confers theright.
The owner of the right to apply for a patent includes an inventor, a designer, and a pledgee.
The successor of the right to apply for a patent can transfer the right to the assignee.
The patent right can be transferred to an assignee after the patent application has been approved.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
opts: A foreign applicant who is not the citizen of WTO members is unable to make a priority claim.
When the earlier patent application is a patent application for invention that has been published, itcannot be claimed as a priority case.
When the earlier patent application has been withdrawn, it cannot be claimed as a priority case.
For a patent application filed with priority, examination on its patentability shall be based on the prioritydate.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
opts: Three inventions related to a single general inventive concept cannot be filed in one application.
A patent application that substantially contains two inventions may request by the applicant to bedivided into two divisional applications.
The filing date of the divisional patent application shall be the same as the filing date of the originalapplication.
The divisional patent application shall not extend beyond the scope of content disclosed in thedescription of the original patent application as filed.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements related to substantive examinationis NOT correct?
opts: All kinds of patent applications have the procedures of substantive examination.
Any person may request for a substantive examination of a patent application for invention.
Design patent applications do not have to request for substantive examinations.
When a request for a substantive examination over a patent application for invention is more than threeyears, the application shall be deemed to have been withdrawn.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements related to utility model patents isNOT correct?
opts: Any person may file a request for a technical evaluation report of a utility model patent.
A patent application for a utility model patent will undergo administrative examination and formalityexamination procedures.
A right holder of utility model patent may not send a warning letter to an accused patent infringerwithout the technical evaluation report to the utility model patent.
The technical evaluation report for exercising the rights to utility model patent shall be assumed tohave the patentability.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements is NOT correct?
opts: The claim may be made against a person who is fully aware that the patent application for inventionhas been laid open but continues to commercially exploit the invention prior to its publication.
If the patent certificate number is not marked on the patented article, the patentee cannot claim damagesfor the infringement.
An invention patent will be assigned a publication number eighteen months after the filing date.
If the patent certificate number cannot be fixed on the patented article, the patentee may make suchmarking on the labels or packaging.

mcq.q: According to the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following statements regarding to the patent invalidationis NOT correct?
opts: The patent invalidation is a kind of public examination.
Whoever possesses legal interests due to the revocation of a patent may file an invalidation action afterthe said patent has become extinguished ipso facto.
The patentee shall provide a response within one month after having been served with a copy of therequest form from the Specific Patent Agency.
The revocation of an invention patent right shall become final and binding if no administrative remedyproceedings are filed.

mcq.q: Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, the right to apply for a patent cannot be the subject of＿＿＿.
Under the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following circumstance does not limit the exclusive rights ofpatents?
opts: Acts done privately and for non-commercial purposes
Necessary acts to exploit the invention for research or experimental purposes
Patentees not practicing or commercializing the invented technology
Vehicles merely passing through the territory of the country

mcq.q: Which of the following concept could best explain why business methods or computer software are oftenargued ineligible for patent protection?
Which of the following does not belong to“secondary considerations”in determining the non-obviousnessrequirement?
opts: The failure of others to solve the problem addressed by the invention
The existence of a long-felt need for the invention
The research and development cost of the invention
The commercial success of the invention

mcq.q: In accordance with Article 24 of the R.O.C. Patent Act, which of the following is NOT listed in thestatutory exclusion from invention patents?
opts: Inventions contrary to public order or morality
